name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.163: Forced subtitles are never uploaded, and a rewrite keeps the flag.
    A forced subtitle carries only the foreign-language scenes, so it is not the
    film's dialogue and SubDL has no counterpart for it: it is observed, never uploaded.
    The previous version recorded that flag on tracks inside the container but dropped
    it for a loose .srt, so such a row said nothing and was invisible to every reader;
    both writers now state it, and a plain row is stated as "no" instead of left silent.
